english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for someone who wants or eats unusually large amounts of food.

examples.english: My younger brother is truly voracious; after finishing a bowl of rice, he wants another serving.
examples.traditional: 我細佬真係大食，食完一碗飯仲要再添。
